description: This file contains utility APIs for RDK logger, including environment variable management functions such as adding, removing, and retrieving environment variables, as well as internal data structures and helper functions.

classes.name: EnvVarNode
classes.description: Linked list node structure for environment variables, containing a number, name, value, and pointer to next node.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Helper function to trim whitespace from the start and end of a string.

methods.name: rdk_logger_env_rem_conf_details
methods.description: Removes all environment variable nodes from the cache and frees memory.

methods.name: rdk_logger_env_add_conf_file
methods.description: Reads a configuration file, parses environment variable definitions, and adds them to the cache.

methods.name: rdk_logger_envGet
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable by name.

methods.name: rdk_logger_envGetValueFromNum
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable by its registered number.

methods.name: rdk_logger_envGetNum
methods.description: Gets the registered number of an environment variable by name.

methods.name: rdk_logger_envGetModFromNum
methods.description: Gets the name of an environment variable by its registered number.
